name_input: M/s EXCELSOURCE INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LI; EXCELSOURCE INTERNATIONAL PVT.LTD.; EXCELSOURCE INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug excelsource-international-private-limited) shows 58,165 total shipment records, 43 trading partners, latest cargo 2026-02-28. Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | EXCELSOURCE INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED | MINING ENGINEERING SERVICES SARL | Wiper for Floor Cleaner CLEANING WIPER- | MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India -> Lubumbashi, Tanzania | 96039000 | BOL 1127508". Same B/L 1127508 covers further lines dated 2026-02-28 to Lubumbashi, Tanzania: HS 94033090 (conference table), 83059020 (strapping clips), 84818030 (stop cock 1/2 inch), 40103999 (V-belt SPC 3000). Top destination ports by count: Lubumbashi 5568, MUNDRA SEA 4340, MUNDRA SEA INMUN1 3681, Dar Es Salaam 1498, Kinshasa 1015. Buyers listed: MINING ENGINEERING SERVICES SARL (9231 shipments), KISANFU MINING SAS (8329), SOCIETE MINIERE DU KATANGA SAS (7133), Mining Engineering Services SARL (3563), SOTRAFER SPRL (2765). Source counter: page claims 58,165 shipments; only 5 individual dated rows were visible in the free view (plus 5 buyer rows and 5 supplier rows) — the 58,165 figure is the portal's own counter, not independently verified.
domestic_evidence: Company website https://www.excelsource.co.in/ states: "Established in 2003, Excelsource International Private Ltd. (EIPL) offers complete sourcing solutions for engineering goods, plants and machineries, consumable items and EPC Service to our clients across the globe." and lists domestic-facing verticals (Mining and Mineral Processing, Transmission Line/Substation, Solar, F&B, Pharma/Chemicals, Water Utilities, Agriculture) plus divisions "Chemsource", "Excel Global Limited", "Metelity & GridSync EPC". No GST turnover band, no GeM/CPPP tender award, no contract value and no annual-report revenue split was found in the pages read. Website self-description only — status declared, not confirmed.
note: Declared HS 851762 (telecom/network equipment) does NOT match the observed shipment lines, which are mining/industrial consumables and general goods (HS 96039000, 94033090, 83059020, 84818030, 40103999). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the database, actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: trader / sourcing agent (buys from Indian and Chinese suppliers — SIROCO HVAC SAS, IRIS ENERGY LLC, Notus Composites Fzc, SHANGHAI GOTION, VINMART (H.K.) — and re-exports to DRC/Zambia/Tanzania mining customers), not a manufacturer of 851762 equipment. Address discrepancy: customs record shows "301/302 SAMPATTI COMPLEX SARDAR BAUG LANE, RACE COURSE" while the company website gives "Excel House, Block 2, 73 East Avenue Corporate, Sarabhai Campus, Bhailal Amin Marg, Near Genda Circle, Vadodara - 390023, Gujarat" — state_claimed Maharashtra is not supported by either source (Gujarat). PAN AAHCS5986K not verified from any public source read; revenue and export value: null (not public in free views). Note: web_search tool was unavailable (connection refused) for this batch, so only direct http_get sources were used.
